pages.content:
Effective September 1, 2026. This procedure covers self-serve subscription changes handled by Finance. Accepted customer terms govern the price and scope. Enterprise amendments need their own commercial review.

## Confirm the instruction

Confirm the account owner's requested change and the applicable terms before scheduling it. Confirmation records the instruction. It does not itself activate the target plan, revise an invoice or establish workspace access.

Finance retains the confirmation time, phase start, target price, processing mode and outcome in `billing_change_schedule` metadata on the resulting Stripe subscription. A completed schedule remains useful history. It is not a new instruction to change the subscription again.

## Apply the scheduled phase

The normal path is a change at the next subscription-period boundary. The target takes effect when that scheduled phase starts, provided the instruction is still current. A withdrawn or superseded instruction must not be applied merely because its original start time has arrived.

Record the applied time and check the resulting subscription price. Until application is recorded, describe the change as scheduled rather than active. Confirmation time, phase start and applied time answer different questions.

## Bill the applicable period

The subscription cycle produces the invoice for the applicable period. Check the invoice's own period, amount and state. A finalized invoice can be open before payment arrives. Payment is a later settlement event, not the normal activation condition for a period-boundary change.

A subsequent subscription change does not rewrite an already-finalized invoice. Any correction or credit needs its own Finance handling and billing evidence. Do not promise a revised amount from the confirmation alone.

## Exception: an immediate upgrade awaiting payment

Finance can select an immediate, payment-gated upgrade instead of the period-boundary path. In that path an invoice can be finalized while the old subscription setting remains effective. The upgrade takes effect only after the associated invoice is successfully paid and the pending update is applied. An open invoice or attempted payment is insufficient. If the pending update expires without application, retain the previous setting and have Finance review the next step.

Do not generalize this exception to every scheduled change. Check the recorded processing mode before explaining which event controls activation.

## Keep billing and access separate

Use [[Commercial terms and billing guide]] for agreement scope and [[Billing integration]] for the boundary between billing and product records. A changed Stripe price does not prove that every workspace or member has new access. Product provisioning and membership require their own evidence. Support coordinates the customer explanation, Finance interprets billing, and the product owners handle an access discrepancy.
